notes.title: Correction of small bugs
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

The last update fixed a few more minor bugs, thank you for the feedback and support all this time. Thanks to you, the game just got better.

notes.title: Fix major bugs and soundtrack to download
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

We have completed a minor update of the game based on your feedback. Fixed minor bugs with jumps and save, now you can get a unique gaming experience in the company with K_Ellen.

In addition, added the original soundtrack, at your request! Enjoy :)
